courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 混凝土重力壩分塊澆築
related.transfer: 可遷移「鋪層體積與供料節拍」與「層狀滲透異向性」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；混凝土重力壩分塊澆築的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Lift volume and supply rhythm" and "Layered permeability anisotropy" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦碾壓層密實、材料配比與層間滲流的品質鏈；混凝土重力壩分塊澆築則以澆塊熱歷程、層面品質與重力壩荷載路徑為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on quality links between RCC compaction, mixture proportions and interlift seepage; Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction centres on block thermal histories, lift-joint quality and gravity-dam load paths, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鋪層體積與供料節拍」與「絕熱溫升與膠結材」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到混凝土重力壩分塊澆築，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「接縫開度與止水變形」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Lift volume and supply rhythm” and “Adiabatic rise and binder heat”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Joint opening and waterstop deformation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 碾壓混凝土壩施工
history.text: 碾壓混凝土把土工式鋪層碾壓和水泥水化材料結合，品質核心由單一強度轉為材料、壓實與層面連續性的共同證據。美國墾務局出版重力壩設計專書，提供施工與結構整合背景。 美國工兵團重力壩設計手冊出版，整理荷載與穩定分析。 碾壓混凝土手冊出版，提供不同大體積澆築方法的比較。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。
history.textEn: RCC combines earthwork-style lift compaction with cement hydration, shifting quality evidence from strength alone toward materials, compaction and interlift continuity. Reclamation publishes Design of Gravity Dams, providing integrated construction and structural context. USACE publishes Gravity Dam Design guidance for loading and stability analysis. The RCC manual is published, enabling comparison with other mass-concrete placement methods. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.
